## Relevant Symbols
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:38` — `case "$ROLE" in implement|verify)`: the only place a role is admitted; `:53-54` tier per role; `:60-63` allowlist per role; `:109` `NAME` per role; `:113-118` `-w` vs `cd`; `:126-127` claim + `queued → implement`; `:135-161` transcription per role. Every one of these is a `case` that gains two arms.
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:80-88` — implement prompt is unconditional (`/hef.agent on it`); the entry `E` already holds `spec_dir`/`phase`, so the tasks-phase prompt is a conditional on `E`.
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:145` — `spec_dir` recorded absolute (`/*` kept, else `$WT/$S`): reuse for the plan role.
- `hooks/ledger.sh next)` — one jq filter; `--stage` is a second `select` over `.phase`/`.pr.url`/`.blocked_on.kind`.
- `hooks/session-start-context.sh:50-55` — `LDIR` from the common dir; the jq string is where the owner pane is appended; the config is `$CWD/.claude/project-status.json` (same file `status-board.sh` reads).
- `tests/smoke.sh` `sr` fixture — fake `claude` creates `.claude/worktrees/<id>` on `-w` and a branch named `<id>`; `srj` asserts the ledger JSON; `sr_log` is the argv log.

## Existing Patterns & Conventions
- Roles are `case` arms in one file; nothing is table-driven — two more arms keep the shape (`:38,:54,:60,:109,:113,:135`).
- Tiers only, `rank()` is the model-id guard (`:52`).
- The worker never writes the ledger; the launcher transcribes `structured_output` (`:135-161`) — the deploy role follows this even though `/hef.babysit` tries `ledger.sh` itself (it fails inside the sandbox; the command tolerates exit 1).
- Allowed tools are one comma-joined string (`:110`, header comment).
- `--dry-run` refused under the sandbox by the host check (`:66-67`) — SC-003 is user-run.
- Permission rule syntax (Claude Code docs): `Bash(prefix *)` prefix match; `Edit(pattern)` / `Write(pattern)` gitignore-style path patterns relative to the project root — `Edit(.specify/**)` allows edits under `.specify/` only. `Bash(/abs/dir/*)` is a prefix rule on the absolute path — no mid-pattern wildcard needed.

## Environment facts that shaped the plan
- A launched session's `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` is the plugin cache copy; when the launcher runs from the same copy (the normal case: `/hef.orchestrate` calls `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session-launch.sh`), `$HERE` equals the worker's hooks dir, so `Bash($HERE/*)` covers every helper the `hef.*` commands call. Running the launcher from the dev repo while the worker uses the cache is the one mismatch; documented, not solved.
- The eval sandbox is not involved (no eval in this feature); the smoke fixture's fake `claude` is the assertion surface.
